question: In which modern day’s State, the University of Vikramasila was located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar.**__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **University of Vikramasila**

 
 
• There were two important centers of learning during the **Pala empire** - **Nalanda and Vikramashila.**
 
• The university is located in the **Bhagalpur district of Bihar.**
 
• The university was founded by the **Pala emperor Dharamapala** during the **late 8th and early 9th century CE.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• A number of monasteries were established during the Pala period and the five important Mahavirahas that grew up were - **Vikramashila, Nalanda, Somapura, Odantapura, and Jagaddala.**
 
• These five different seats of Buddhist learning worked together as a network of an interlinked group of institutions.
 
• The university had around a hundred teachers and more than a thousand students and it prospered for about 4 centuries.
 
• The subjects taught were - **philosophy, grammar, metaphysics, Buddhist tantra, etc.**
 
• It produced many eminent scholars like **Atisha Dipankar**, who was one of the founders of the Sarma traditions of Tibetan Buddhism.
 
• The university was destroyed by **Muhammad bin Bakhtiyar Khilji around 1193.**
 
• The Tibetan sources, like the writings of **Taranatha** (Tibetan monk historian), are a major source of information about the university.
 
• **Nalanda University** was founded during the **5th century** by **King Kumaragupta I.**
 
• It was also destroyed by **Muhammad bin Bakhtiyar Khilji around 1200 CE.**
